hypothesis.description: The boundary-crossing claim being investigated (the starting question of the Capability Abstraction methodology, before any tool/technique is named).

chokepoint.description: The invariant control boundary the hypothesis crosses — must survive swapping the underlying API/tool (Survives-Tool-Swap Check).

residue-type.description: Category of observable/influenceable evidence left at the chokepoint. One of: telemetry, policy, user-interaction, object-access, protocol, credential, timing, state-transition.

residue-description.description: What is actually observable or influenceable at the chokepoint — the concrete evidence chain, independent of any specific tool.

survives-tool-swap.description: Whether the chokepoint/residue pair still holds if the underlying API or tool is swapped for an equivalent one. True/false per the methodology's own completeness check.

abstraction-layer.description: SpecterOps 'On Detection: Tactical to Functional' / Summiting the Pyramid capability-abstraction layer this hypothesis is pinned to. Fixed vocabulary only — never a free-text category like 'Dataset'.

robustness-level.description: Center for Threat-Informed Defense 'Summiting the Pyramid' robustness level (https://center-for-threat-informed-defense.github.io/summiting-the-pyramid/). Fixed vocabulary only, verbatim CTID level names — there is no Medium/High rating.
sane_default: Level 5: Invariant Behaviors / Core to Technique

event-robustness-column.description: Center for Threat-Informed Defense 'Summiting the Pyramid' event robustness column — where the event data originates. Host-based: A (Application), U (User-Mode), K (Kernel-Mode). Network traffic: P (Payload Visibility), H (Header Visibility). Fixed vocabulary only. Report alongside robustness-level as a combined code (e.g. Level 5 + Column K = '5K').

attack-technique-id.description: Downstream ATT&CK technique mapping, applied LAST per doctrine (after hypothesis/chokepoint/residue are established). Prefer a MISP Galaxy cluster reference over this attribute when the target instance has ATT&CK galaxies enabled; use this attribute as a portable fallback for instances/exports without galaxy support.

engage-activity-id.description: MITRE Engage activity ID, when the hypothesis is deception-relevant.

title.description: Human-readable title. Maps directly to the HEFAISTOS Waiting Room Partner API 'title' field for lossless round-trip.

short-description.description: Short summary. Maps directly to the HEFAISTOS Waiting Room Partner API 'short_description' field.

detection-objective.description: What the resulting detection is meant to catch. Maps directly to the HEFAISTOS Waiting Room Partner API 'detection_objective' field.

estimated-detection-complexity.description: Rough engineering-effort estimate for building the detection: low, medium, high. Maps to the HEFAISTOS Partner API 'estimated_detection_complexity' field.

hefaistos-layer-id.description: Ties this object back to a HEX v2.0 capability_abstraction.layers[].layer_id once promoted into a HEFAISTOS Workbench. Left empty on initial creation — populated only after promotion, for traceability back to MISP from HEFAISTOS.

hefaistos-workbench-ref.description: Link back to the originating HEFAISTOS Workbench/Waiting Room item, once promoted.

source-lane.description: Which Hermes/Capability Abstraction lane produced this object (e.g. daily-capability-abstraction-master-self-improvement, weekly-capability-abstraction-implementer). For provenance/audit only.

detection-query.description: The raw detection query/rule text (KQL, EQL, SPL, Sigma, etc.) that this hypothesis is grounded in or intended to produce. Kept as plain text, language-agnostic — no attempt to normalize to a single query DSL. Populated by producers like Arkona Forge's 'to-misp' command; left empty for hypothesis-only entries (e.g. the daily Capability Abstraction research lane).

detection-query-language.description: The query language of detection-query (e.g. kql, eql, spl, sigma, wazuh). For display/syntax-highlighting context only.

quality-scorecard-checked.description: Whether attack-technique-id/engage-activity-id values were validated against the local ATT&CK/Engage reference files by the capability-abstraction quality scorecard before this object was created. False/absent means unvalidated — downstream consumers should treat ATT&CK/Engage IDs as unverified until this is true.

description: A capability-abstraction hypothesis (chokepoint + residue pair) produced by the Capability Abstraction detection-engineering methodology, structured for round-trip compatibility with HEFAISTOS Waiting Room import (via importWaitingCasesFromMisp) and the HEFAISTOS Partner Integration API field vocabulary. ATT&CK/Engage mapping is deliberately downstream/optional per doctrine: hypothesis -> capability abstraction -> invariant chokepoint -> residue -> detection/deception -> ATT&CK last.
name: capability-abstraction
